copy.curiosityHook: As MacLeod faces his own mortality, what lingering secret from planet Zeist brings General Katana across worlds to finish him off?
copy.description: Now mortal and nearing the end of his life, Connor MacLeod is haunted by resurfacing memories of the planet Zeist, just as his vengeful old enemy, General Katana, plots his ultimate destruction.
copy.vibeSummary: Fast-paced, suspenseful sci-fi fantasy with exciting action, moderate emotional stakes, and energetic spectacle perfect for friends.
copy.whyWatch: Director Russell Mulcahy takes the fantasy saga into bold science-fiction territory, delivering fast-moving action and high-stakes adventure with persistent suspense.
